title: Inex One Opens Expert Network Access to Self-Serve Users at $500 per Project
summary: Inex One launched a self-serve plan that lets corporate professionals sign up, pay by card, and book expert calls the same day. The plan costs $500 per project and gives access to more than 30 expert networks, with no subscriptions, prepayments, or minimum spend; calls are billed hourly at the network's rate, which Inex One puts at typically $1,000–1,250. Users can cancel free of charge within the first ten minutes of a call if the expert is not a good fit. The company says it has more than 8,000 clients.
whyItMatters: Card-based, no-commitment access lowers the entry barrier for corporate and occasional users who have historically been locked out by prepaid credit contracts, and publishes price points the industry rarely discloses.
